Name: Geode Upgrader for CFR
Author: SuperPiggeh778
Description:
Adds a new machine to upgrade geodes.

[u]Installation:[/u]

[list]
[*]Download "Custom Farming Redux"
[*]Place this mod inside steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\CustomFarmingRedux\Machines.
[*]Load up the game!
[/list]
[u]Usage:[/u]

[list]
[*]Craft or buy from Clint
[*]50 stone + Geode = Frozen Geode
[*]50 stone + Frozen Geode = Magma Geode
[*]50 stone + Magma Geode = Omni Geode
[*]50 stone + Omni Geode = actually, just don't put an omni geode in this machine. trust me.
[/list]
Please let me know of any bugs or suggestions, and enjoy the mod :)
